requirements.title: AOF must provide a bounded reproduction drill for next-task judgment
requirements.acceptance_boundary: covered when the reproduction record contains current situation, candidate comparison, selected task, bounded evidence path, Go/No-Go, and human next action

requirements.title: v11.1 must not overclaim external validation
requirements.acceptance_boundary: covered when release boundary and audit explicitly state that actual third-party comprehension, market truth, semantic truth, and adoption are not proven

forecast.estimated_token_cost_range: bounded release framing, reproduction audit, test and smoke verification
forecast.forecast_boundary: forecast is release planning evidence, not delivery certainty

not_proven: Requirement coverage proves structural linkage only; it does not prove actual external operator success, semantic truth, productivity gain, or adoption.
